data/processed/curriculum_clean_v1/pages.status: SOURCE — contains evaluation pages by design, not a training corpus

verdict: CLEAN — no training corpus contains held-out material
note: curriculum_clean_v1 is the SOURCE the evaluation sets were cut from, so it necessarily contains them. It must never be used directly as a training corpus; a training corpus has to be built with the held-out books excluded.
limitations: Fingerprint is the first 400 characters after whitespace normalisation. It catches identical and near-identical pages, not paraphrase or partial overlap, and not a document that merely shares a topic.
